premises.text: Microplastics are a significant health concern as they are consumed daily by people.
premises.evidence_span: you and your children are eating five grams of microplastic every single day

premises.text: PBA is a type of microplastic found in common household products like laundry pods.
premises.evidence_span: PBA, polyvinyl alcohol... found in this, the detergent laundry pot, which is also known as Tide Pods

premises.text: The production of laundry pods contributes significantly to microplastic pollution in oceans.
premises.evidence_span: 8,000 tons of these microplastics flow into the ocean

premises.text: Matero has developed a patented technology to replace PBA with bio-based polymer.
premises.evidence_span: Matero has developed the world's first and only solution to replace PBA with bowel-based polymer

premises.text: Agricultural waste can be upcycled into bio-based polymers using Matero's technology.
premises.evidence_span: We upcycle a variety of agricultural waste, ranging from dairy waste to beer waste

premises.text: The bio-based polymer can be processed using existing plastic manufacturing equipment.
premises.evidence_span: processed into these bio-based resins through existing plastic manufacturing equipment

premises.text: The bio-based solution can replace PVA in various applications, including laundry pods and textiles.
premises.evidence_span: our polymer can be used for construction as glue, for textile, as t-shirt

premises.text: Matero has established partnerships with major companies like Unilever and Enheuser-Busch InBev.
premises.evidence_span: partnership with Enheuser-Busch InBev and Unilever

premises.text: The production process of the bio-based polymer is environmentally friendly, producing less CO2.
premises.evidence_span: we produce much lesser CO2 while requiring much lesser energy consumption

premises.text: Matero aims to significantly scale production and revenue by 2030.
premises.evidence_span: By 2030, our goal is to generate $400 million from 100,000 tons of production

value.text: Matero provides a sustainable alternative to PVA, reducing microplastic pollution.
value.evidence_span: help us to replace PVA once for all

notes: Revenue projections and traction metrics are excluded as they do not support premises.
